    (Hwf : wf_r_config CT sΓ rΓ h)

===== Syntax.v =====
From Stdlib Require List.

Require Import Stdlib.Sets.Ensembles.

Definition var : Type := nat.

Definition method_name : Type := nat.

Definition class_name : Type := nat.

Inductive q : Type :=

  | Mut
  | Imm
  | RDM

  | RO

  | Lost
  | Bot.

Inductive q_f : Type :=

  | Mut_f
  | Imm_f
  | RDM_f

  | RO_f.

Inductive q_c : Type :=

  | Mut_c
  | Imm_c
  | RDM_c.

Inductive a : Type :=
  | Assignable
  | Final
  | RDA.

Record qualified_type := {
  sqtype: q;
  sctype: class_name;
}.

Definition s_env := list qualified_type.

Inductive expr : Type :=
  | ENull : expr
  | EVar : var -> expr
  | EField : var -> var -> expr.

Inductive stmt: Type :=
  | SSkip: stmt
  | SLocal: qualified_type -> var -> stmt
  | SVarAss: var -> expr -> stmt
  | SFldWrite: var -> var -> var -> stmt
  | SNew: var -> q_c -> class_name -> list var -> stmt
  | SCall: var -> var -> method_name -> list var -> stmt

  | SSeq: stmt -> stmt -> stmt.

Record field_type := {
  assignability: a;
  mutability: q_f;
  f_base_type : class_name;
}.

Record field_def := {
  ftype : field_type;
  fname : var;
}.

Record constructor_body :={
  assignments: list (var * var);
}.

Record constructor_sig := {
  cqualifier: q_c;
  cparams : list qualified_type;
}.

Record constructor_def := {
  csignature : constructor_sig;

}.

Record method_body := {
  mbody_stmt: stmt;
  mreturn: var;
}.

Inductive method_scope : Type :=
  | AbstractState
  | ConcreteState
  | ReadonlyState
  | TransitiveState.

Definition readonly_state_method_scope (mt : method_scope) : Prop :=
  mt = ReadonlyState \/ mt = TransitiveState.

Definition strict_assignability_method_scope (mt : method_scope) : Prop :=
  mt = ConcreteState \/ mt = TransitiveState.

Record method_sig := {
  mscope: method_scope;
  mret : qualified_type;
  mname : method_name;
  mreceiver: qualified_type;
  mparams : list qualified_type;
}.

Record method_def := {
  msignature : method_sig;
  mbody : method_body;
}.

Record class_body := {
  fields : list field_def;
  constructor: constructor_def;
  methods : list method_def;
}.

Record class_sig := {
  class_qualifier : q_c;
  cname : class_name;
  super : option class_name;
}.

Record class_def := {
  signature : class_sig;
  body : class_body;
}.

Record program_def := {
  classes: list class_def;
  main_statement: stmt;
}.

Definition class_table := list class_def.

Inductive q_r : Type :=
  | Mut_r
  | Imm_r
  .

Record runtime_type := mkruntime_type {
  rqtype: q_r;
  rctype: class_name;
}.

Definition Loc : Type := nat.

Inductive value : Type :=
  | Null_a : value
  | Iot: Loc -> value.

Definition var_mapping   := list value.

Record r_env := mkr_env {
  vars: var_mapping;
}.

Definition set_vars (_ : r_env) (vars' : var_mapping) : r_env :=
  mkr_env vars'.

Definition fields_mapping := list value.

Record Obj := mkObj {
  rt_type: runtime_type;
  fields_map: fields_mapping;
}.

Definition set_fields_map (o : Obj) (fields' : fields_mapping) : Obj :=
  mkObj (rt_type o) fields'.

Definition heap          := list Obj.
===== Notations.v =====
Reserved Notation "q1 ⊑ q2" (at level 40).

Reserved Notation "T1 <: T2" (at level 40).

Reserved Notation "[ x ↦  y ] σ" (at level 0).

Reserved Notation "[ x ⟼ y ] σ" (at level 0).

Notation "'dom' x" := (length x) (at level 0, x at level 1).
===== Helpers.v =====
Require Export Syntax.

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Import ListNotations.

Require Export Notations.

Require Export ssreflect ssrbool Stdlib.Sets.Finite_sets_facts.

Definition gget {X: Type} (l : list X)  : Loc -> option X := nth_error l.

Definition runtime_getObj (l : heap)    : Loc -> option Obj := nth_error l.

Definition getVal (l : list value)  : Loc -> option value := nth_error l.

Definition runtime_getVal (rΓ : r_env): Loc -> option value := nth_error (rΓ.(vars)).

Definition static_getType (sΓ: s_env): Loc -> option qualified_type := nth_error sΓ.

Fixpoint mapM {A B : Type} (f : A -> option B) (l : list A) : option (list B) :=
  match l with
  | [] => Some []
  | x :: xs =>
      match f x, mapM f xs with
      | Some y, Some ys => Some (y :: ys)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  end.

Definition static_getType_list (sΓ: s_env): list Loc -> option (list qualified_type) :=
  fun l => mapM (fun x => static_getType sΓ x) l.

Definition runtime_lookup_list (rΓ: r_env): list Loc -> option (list value) :=
  fun l => mapM (fun x => runtime_getVal rΓ x) l.

Fixpoint forallb2 {A B} (f : A -> B -> bool) (l1 : list A) (l2 : list B) : bool :=
  match l1, l2 with
  | [], [] => true
  | x1 :: xs1, x2 :: xs2 => f x1 x2 && forallb2 f xs1 xs2
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Fixpoint update {X : Type} (position : nat) (value : X) (l : list X) : list X :=
  match l, position with
  | [], _ => []
  | _::t, 0 => value :: t
  | h::l', S n => h :: update n value l'
  end.

Notation "[ x ↦  v ] l" := (update x v l) (at level 0).

Definition update_r_env_value (rΓ : r_env) (l : Loc) (v : value) : r_env :=
  match rΓ with
  {| vars := vars; |} =>
      {| vars := update l v vars;|}
  end.

Definition find_class (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option class_def :=
    gget CT C.

Definition bound (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option q_c :=
  match find_class CT C with
  | Some decl => Some (class_qualifier (signature decl))
  | None => None
  end.
===== Subtyping.v =====
From Stdlib Require Import List.

Require Import Stdlib.Classes.RelationClasses.

Import ListNotations.

Require Import Syntax Notations Helpers.

Inductive method_scope_subtype : method_scope -> method_scope -> Prop :=
  | method_subtyping_refl : forall mt,
      method_scope_subtype mt mt
  | method_cs_as : method_scope_subtype ConcreteState AbstractState
  | method_rs_as : method_scope_subtype ReadonlyState AbstractState
  | method_ts_as : method_scope_subtype TransitiveState AbstractState
  | method_ts_cs : method_scope_subtype TransitiveState ConcreteState
  | method_ts_rs : method_scope_subtype TransitiveState ReadonlyState
  .

Inductive q_subtype : q -> q -> Prop :=
  | q_refl : forall q1
      (Hnot_lost : q1 <> Lost),
      q_subtype q1 q1
  | q_rd : forall q1,
      q_subtype q1 RO
  | q_bot : forall q1,
      q_subtype Bot q1
where "q1 ⊑ q2" := (q_subtype q1 q2).

Definition parent_lookup (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option class_name :=
  match find_class CT C with
  | Some def => super (signature def)
  | None => None
  end.

Inductive base_subtype : class_table -> class_name -> class_name -> Prop :=
  | base_refl : forall (CT : class_table) (C : class_name)
      (Hdom : C < dom CT),
      base_subtype CT C C
  | base_trans : forall (CT : class_table) (C D E : class_name)
      (Hsub1 : base_subtype CT C D)
      (Hsub2 : base_subtype CT D E),
      base_subtype CT C E
  | base_extends : forall (CT : class_table) (C D : class_name)
      (Hdom_C  : C < dom CT)
      (Hdom_D  : D < dom CT)
      (Hparent : parent_lookup CT C = Some D),
      base_subtype CT C D.

Inductive qualified_type_subtype : class_table -> qualified_type -> qualified_type -> Prop :=
  | qtype_sub : forall CT qt1 qt2
      (Hdom1  : sctype qt1 < dom CT)
      (Hdom2  : sctype qt2 < dom CT)
      (Hqsub  : q_subtype (sqtype qt1) (sqtype qt2))
      (Hbsub  : base_subtype CT (sctype qt1) (sctype qt2)),
      qualified_type_subtype CT qt1 qt2
  | qtype_trans : forall CT qt1 qt2 qt3
      (Hsub12 : qualified_type_subtype CT qt1 qt2)
      (Hsub23 : qualified_type_subtype CT qt2 qt3),
      qualified_type_subtype CT qt1 qt3
  | qtype_refl : forall CT qt
      (Hdom      : sctype qt < dom CT)
      (Hnot_lost : sqtype qt <> Lost),
      qualified_type_subtype CT qt qt.
===== ViewpointAdaptation.v =====
Require Import Syntax.

Definition vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (q1: q)(q2 : q) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM => Lost
    | q1, RDM => q1
    | _, q2 => q2
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_tt_abstract_state (t1: qualified_type)(t2 : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=
  Build_qualified_type
    (vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (sqtype t1) (sqtype t2))
    (sctype t2).

Definition vpa_mutability_stype_fld_abstract_state (q1: q)(q2 : q_f) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM_f => Lost
    | q1, RDM_f => q1
    | _, Imm_f => Imm
    | _, Mut_f => Mut
    | _, RO_f => RO
    end.

Definition vpa_mutability_qq_readonly_state (q1: q)(q2 : q) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM => Lost
    | q1, RDM => q1
    | Mut, Mut => Mut
    | _, Mut => Lost
    | _, q2 => q2
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_tt_readonly_state (t1: qualified_type)(t2 : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=
  Build_qualified_type
    (vpa_mutability_qq_readonly_state (sqtype t1) (sqtype t2))
    (sctype t2).

Definition vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state (q1: q)(q2 : q_f) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with






    | RO, RDM_f => Lost
    | q1, RDM_f => q1
    | _, Imm_f => Imm
    | Mut, Mut_f => Mut
    | _, Mut_f => Lost
    | _, RO_f => RO
    end.

Definition vpa_assignability (q1: q) (a1: a) : a :=
  match q1, a1 with
    | Mut, RDA => Assignable
    | _, Assignable => Assignable
    | _, _ => Final
  end.

Definition vpa_assignability_cs_ts (q1: q) (a1: a) : a :=
  match q1, a1 with
    | Mut, RDA => Assignable
    | Mut, Assignable => Assignable
    | _, _ => Final
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_bound (q1: q)(q2 : q_c) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM_c => Lost
    | q1, RDM_c => q1
    | _, Imm_c => Imm
    | _, Mut_c => Mut
    end.

Definition vpa_mutability_constructor_fld (q1: q_c)(q2 : q_f) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | Imm_c, RDM_f => Imm
    | Mut_c, RDM_f => Mut
    | RDM_c, RDM_f => RDM
    | _, Imm_f => Imm
    | _, Mut_f => Mut
    | _, RO_f => RO
    end.

Definition vpa_mutability_rec_fld (q1: q_r)(q2 : q_f) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | Imm_r, RDM_f => Imm
    | Mut_r, RDM_f => Mut
    | _, Imm_f => Imm
    | _, Mut_f => Mut
    | _, RO_f => RO
    end.

Definition vpa_mutability_runtime (q1: q_r)(q2 : q) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | Imm_r, RDM => Imm
    | Mut_r, RDM => Mut
    | _, q2 => q2
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_object_creation (q1: q_r)(q2 : q_c) : q_r :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | Imm_r, RDM_c => Imm_r
    | Mut_r, RDM_c => Mut_r
    | _, Imm_c => Imm_r
    | _, Mut_c => Mut_r
    end.
===== Reachability.v =====
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

From Stdlib Require Import List.

From Stdlib Require String.

Require Import Stdlib.Sets.Ensembles.

Require Import Stdlib.Classes.RelationClasses.

Import ListNotations.

Require Import Syntax Typing Subtyping ViewpointAdaptation Helpers.

Inductive reachable (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=

  | rch_heap : forall l
      (Hdom : l < dom h),
      reachable h l l

  | rch_step : forall l0 l1 obj f
      (Hdom    : l1 < dom h)
      (Hobj    : runtime_getObj h l0 = Some obj)
      (Hfield  : getVal obj.(fields_map) f = Some (Iot l1)),
      reachable h l0 l1

  | rch_trans : forall l0 l1 l2
      (Hreach1 : reachable h l0 l1)
      (Hreach2 : reachable h l1 l2),
      reachable h l0 l2.

Definition heap_edge (h : heap) (l0 l1 : Loc) : Prop :=
  exists obj f,
    runtime_getObj h l0 = Some obj /\
    getVal obj.(fields_map) f = Some (Iot l1) /\
    l1 < dom h.

Inductive edge_path (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> list Loc -> Prop :=
  | edge_path_nil : forall l,
      edge_path h l l []
  | edge_path_cons : forall l0 l1 l2 nodes,
      heap_edge h l0 l1 ->
      edge_path h l1 l2 nodes ->
      edge_path h l0 l2 (l1 :: nodes).

Fixpoint reachable_in (h : heap) (fuel : nat) (l0 l1 : Loc) : Prop :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => l0 = l1
  | S fuel' =>
      l0 = l1 \/
      exists next, heap_edge h l0 next /\ reachable_in h fuel' next l1
  end.

Inductive reachable_abs (CT : class_table) (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=

  | reachable_abs_heap : forall l
      (Hdom : l < dom h),
      reachable_abs CT h l l

  | reachable_abs_step : forall l0 l1 any C vals k
      (Hdom        : l1 < dom h)
      (Hobj        : runtime_getObj h l0 = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type any C) vals))
      (Hfield      : nth_error vals k = Some (Iot l1))
      (Hmut_abs    : sf_mutability_rel CT C k RDM_f \/ sf_mutability_rel CT C k Imm_f)
      (Hassign_abs : sf_assignability_rel CT C k RDA \/ sf_assignability_rel CT C k Final),
      reachable_abs CT h l0 l1

  | reachable_abs_trans : forall l0 l1 l2
      (Hreach1 : reachable_abs CT h l0 l1)
      (Hreach2 : reachable_abs CT h l1 l2),
      reachable_abs CT h l0 l2.

Definition protected_locset
  (CT : class_table) (h : heap) (l_root : Loc) : Ensembles.Ensemble Loc :=
  fun l_target => reachable_abs CT h l_root l_target.

Definition get_this_var_mapping (vm : var_mapping) : option Loc :=
  match vm with
  | [] => None
  | ι :: _ =>
    match ι with
    | Null_a => None
    | Iot loc => Some loc
    end
  end.

Definition r_muttype (h: heap) (ι: Loc) : option q_r :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => None
  | Some o => Some (rqtype (rt_type o))
  end.

Definition r_basetype (h: heap) (ι: Loc) : option class_name :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => None
  | Some o => Some (rctype (rt_type o))
  end.

Definition r_type (h: heap) (ι: Loc) : option runtime_type :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => None
  | Some o => Some (rt_type o)
  end.

Definition update_field (h: heap) (ι: Loc) (f: var) (v: value) : heap :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => h
  | Some o =>
      let new_fields := update f v o.(fields_map) in
      let new_obj := (set_fields_map o (new_fields))
      in update ι new_obj h
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_runtime_bound_agree (q1: q_r)(q2 : q_c) : bool :=
  match (q1, q2) with
    | (Imm_r, RDM_c) => true
    | (Mut_r, RDM_c) => true
    | (Imm_r, Imm_c) => true
    | (Mut_r, Mut_c) => true
    | (_, _) => false
    end.

Definition wf_rtypeuse (CT: class_table) (q: q_r) (c: class_name) : Prop :=
  match (bound CT c) with
  | None => False
  | Some q' => c < dom CT /\ vpa_mutability_runtime_bound_agree q q'
  end.

Definition qualifier_typable_context (qr: q_r) (qs: q) (qcontext: q_r): Prop :=
  match qr with
  | Imm_r =>
    match vpa_mutability_runtime qcontext qs with
    | Imm => True
    | RO => True
    | Lost => True
    | _ => False
    end
  | Mut_r =>
    match vpa_mutability_runtime qcontext qs with
    | Mut => True
    | RO => True
    | Lost => True
    | _ => False
    end
  end.

Definition qualifier_typable_heap (qr: q_r) (qs: q): Prop :=
  match qr with
  | Imm_r =>
    match qs with
    | Imm => True
    | RO => True
    | _ => False
    end
  | Mut_r =>
    match qs with
    | Mut => True
    | RO => True
    | _ => False
    end
  end.

Definition wf_obj (CT: class_table) (h: heap) (ι: Loc) : Prop :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => False
  | Some o =>

      wf_rtypeuse CT (rt_type o).(rqtype) (rt_type o).(rctype) /\

      exists field_defs, CollectFields CT (rt_type o).(rctype) field_defs /\
      List.length (fields_map o) = List.length field_defs /\
      Forall2 (fun v fdef =>
        match v with
        | Null_a => True
        | Iot loc =>
          match runtime_getObj h loc with
          | Some _ =>

            exists rqt, r_type h loc = Some rqt /\
            base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (f_base_type (ftype fdef)) /\
            qualifier_typable_heap (rqtype rqt) (vpa_mutability_rec_fld (rqtype (rt_type o)) (mutability (ftype fdef)))
          | None => False
          end
        end) (fields_map o) field_defs
  end.

Definition wf_renv (CT: class_table) (rΓ: r_env) (h: heap) : Prop :=

  dom rΓ.(vars) > 0 /\
  (exists iot, get_this_var_mapping rΓ.(vars) = Some iot /\ iot < dom h) /\
  Forall (fun value =>
    match value with
    | Null_a => True
    | Iot loc =>
        match runtime_getObj h loc with
        | None => False
        | Some _ => True
        end
    end) rΓ.(vars).

Definition wf_heap (CT: class_table) (h: heap) : Prop :=
    forall (ι : Loc),
    ι < (List.length h) ->
    wf_obj CT h ι.

Definition wf_r_typable (CT: class_table) (h: heap) (ι: Loc)
  (sqt: qualified_type) (qcontext: q_r) : Prop :=
  match r_type h ι with
  | Some rqt =>
      base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype sqt) /\
      qualifier_typable_context (rqtype rqt) (sqtype sqt) qcontext
  | _ => False
  end.

Definition wf_r_config (CT: class_table) (sΓ: s_env) (rΓ: r_env) (h: heap) : Prop :=

  wf_class_table CT /\

  wf_heap CT h /\

  wf_renv CT rΓ h /\

  wf_senv CT sΓ /\

  List.length sΓ = List.length rΓ.(vars) /\
  forall ι qcontext,
  get_this_var_mapping (vars rΓ) = Some ι ->
  (r_muttype h ι) = Some qcontext ->
  forall i, i < List.length sΓ ->
  forall sqt,

    nth_error sΓ i = Some sqt ->
    match runtime_getVal rΓ i with
    | Some (Iot loc) => wf_r_typable CT h loc sqt qcontext
    | Some Null_a => True
    | None => False
    end.

| OK : eval_result
| MUTATIONEXP: eval_result
| NPE : eval_result.

Definition runtime_vpa_assignability (q1: q_r) (a1: a) : a :=
  match q1, a1 with
    | _, Assignable => Assignable
    | Mut_r, RDA => Assignable
    | _, _ => Final
  end.

Definition reachable_locations_from_initial_env
  (h : heap) (rΓ : r_env) : Ensembles.Ensemble Loc :=
  fun l_target =>
    exists x l_root ,
      runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot l_root) /\
      reachable h l_root l_target.

Inductive eval_expr : class_table -> r_env -> heap -> expr -> value -> eval_result -> r_env -> heap -> Prop :=

  | EBS_Null : forall CT rΓ h,
      eval_expr CT rΓ h ENull Null_a OK rΓ h


  | EBS_Val : forall CT rΓ h x v

From Stdlib Require List.

Require Import Stdlib.Sets.Ensembles.

Definition var : Type := nat.

Definition method_name : Type := nat.

Definition class_name : Type := nat.

Inductive q : Type :=

  | Mut
  | Imm
  | RDM

  | RO

  | Lost
  | Bot.

Inductive q_f : Type :=

  | Mut_f
  | Imm_f
  | RDM_f

  | RO_f.

Inductive q_c : Type :=

  | Mut_c
  | Imm_c
  | RDM_c.

Inductive a : Type :=
  | Assignable
  | Final
  | RDA.

Record qualified_type := {
  sqtype: q;
  sctype: class_name;
}.

Definition s_env := list qualified_type.

Inductive expr : Type :=
  | ENull : expr
  | EVar : var -> expr
  | EField : var -> var -> expr.

Inductive stmt: Type :=
  | SSkip: stmt
  | SLocal: qualified_type -> var -> stmt
  | SVarAss: var -> expr -> stmt
  | SFldWrite: var -> var -> var -> stmt
  | SNew: var -> q_c -> class_name -> list var -> stmt
  | SCall: var -> var -> method_name -> list var -> stmt

  | SSeq: stmt -> stmt -> stmt.

Record field_type := {
  assignability: a;
  mutability: q_f;
  f_base_type : class_name;
}.

Record field_def := {
  ftype : field_type;
  fname : var;
}.

Record constructor_body :={
  assignments: list (var * var);
}.

Record constructor_sig := {
  cqualifier: q_c;
  cparams : list qualified_type;
}.

Record constructor_def := {
  csignature : constructor_sig;

}.

Record method_body := {
  mbody_stmt: stmt;
  mreturn: var;
}.

Inductive method_scope : Type :=
  | AbstractState
  | ConcreteState
  | ReadonlyState
  | TransitiveState.

Definition readonly_state_method_scope (mt : method_scope) : Prop :=
  mt = ReadonlyState \/ mt = TransitiveState.

Definition strict_assignability_method_scope (mt : method_scope) : Prop :=
  mt = ConcreteState \/ mt = TransitiveState.

Record method_sig := {
  mscope: method_scope;
  mret : qualified_type;
  mname : method_name;
  mreceiver: qualified_type;
  mparams : list qualified_type;
}.

Record method_def := {
  msignature : method_sig;
  mbody : method_body;
}.

Record class_body := {
  fields : list field_def;
  constructor: constructor_def;
  methods : list method_def;
}.

Record class_sig := {
  class_qualifier : q_c;
  cname : class_name;
  super : option class_name;
}.

Record class_def := {
  signature : class_sig;
  body : class_body;
}.

Record program_def := {
  classes: list class_def;
  main_statement: stmt;
}.

Definition class_table := list class_def.

  | Mut_r
  | Imm_r
  .

Require Export Syntax.

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Import ListNotations.

Require Export Notations.

Require Export ssreflect ssrbool Stdlib.Sets.Finite_sets_facts.

Definition gget {X: Type} (l : list X)  : Loc -> option X := nth_error l.

Definition runtime_getObj (l : heap)    : Loc -> option Obj := nth_error l.

Definition getVal (l : list value)  : Loc -> option value := nth_error l.

Definition runtime_getVal (rΓ : r_env): Loc -> option value := nth_error (rΓ.(vars)).

Definition static_getType (sΓ: s_env): Loc -> option qualified_type := nth_error sΓ.

Fixpoint mapM {A B : Type} (f : A -> option B) (l : list A) : option (list B) :=
  match l with
  | [] => Some []
  | x :: xs =>
      match f x, mapM f xs with
      | Some y, Some ys => Some (y :: ys)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  end.

Definition static_getType_list (sΓ: s_env): list Loc -> option (list qualified_type) :=
  fun l => mapM (fun x => static_getType sΓ x) l.

Definition runtime_lookup_list (rΓ: r_env): list Loc -> option (list value) :=
  fun l => mapM (fun x => runtime_getVal rΓ x) l.

Fixpoint forallb2 {A B} (f : A -> B -> bool) (l1 : list A) (l2 : list B) : bool :=
  match l1, l2 with
  | [], [] => true
  | x1 :: xs1, x2 :: xs2 => f x1 x2 && forallb2 f xs1 xs2
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Fixpoint update {X : Type} (position : nat) (value : X) (l : list X) : list X :=
  match l, position with
  | [], _ => []
  | _::t, 0 => value :: t
  | h::l', S n => h :: update n value l'
  end.

Notation "[ x ↦  v ] l" := (update x v l) (at level 0).

Definition update_r_env_value (rΓ : r_env) (l : Loc) (v : value) : r_env :=
  match rΓ with
  {| vars := vars; |} =>
      {| vars := update l v vars;|}
  end.

Definition find_class (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option class_def :=
    gget CT C.

Definition bound (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option q_c :=
  match find_class CT C with
  | Some decl => Some (class_qualifier (signature decl))
  | None => None
  end.

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Require Import Stdlib.Classes.RelationClasses.

Import ListNotations.

Require Import Syntax Notations Helpers.

Inductive method_scope_subtype : method_scope -> method_scope -> Prop :=
  | method_subtyping_refl : forall mt,
      method_scope_subtype mt mt
  | method_cs_as : method_scope_subtype ConcreteState AbstractState
  | method_rs_as : method_scope_subtype ReadonlyState AbstractState
  | method_ts_as : method_scope_subtype TransitiveState AbstractState
  | method_ts_cs : method_scope_subtype TransitiveState ConcreteState
  | method_ts_rs : method_scope_subtype TransitiveState ReadonlyState
  .

Inductive q_subtype : q -> q -> Prop :=
  | q_refl : forall q1
      (Hnot_lost : q1 <> Lost),
      q_subtype q1 q1
  | q_rd : forall q1,
      q_subtype q1 RO
  | q_bot : forall q1,
      q_subtype Bot q1
where "q1 ⊑ q2" := (q_subtype q1 q2).

Definition parent_lookup (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option class_name :=
  match find_class CT C with
  | Some def => super (signature def)
  | None => None
  end.

Inductive base_subtype : class_table -> class_name -> class_name -> Prop :=
  | base_refl : forall (CT : class_table) (C : class_name)
      (Hdom : C < dom CT),
      base_subtype CT C C
  | base_trans : forall (CT : class_table) (C D E : class_name)
      (Hsub1 : base_subtype CT C D)
      (Hsub2 : base_subtype CT D E),
      base_subtype CT C E
  | base_extends : forall (CT : class_table) (C D : class_name)
      (Hdom_C  : C < dom CT)
      (Hdom_D  : D < dom CT)
      (Hparent : parent_lookup CT C = Some D),
      base_subtype CT C D.

Inductive qualified_type_subtype : class_table -> qualified_type -> qualified_type -> Prop :=
  | qtype_sub : forall CT qt1 qt2
      (Hdom1  : sctype qt1 < dom CT)
      (Hdom2  : sctype qt2 < dom CT)
      (Hqsub  : q_subtype (sqtype qt1) (sqtype qt2))
      (Hbsub  : base_subtype CT (sctype qt1) (sctype qt2)),
      qualified_type_subtype CT qt1 qt2
  | qtype_trans : forall CT qt1 qt2 qt3
      (Hsub12 : qualified_type_subtype CT qt1 qt2)
      (Hsub23 : qualified_type_subtype CT qt2 qt3),
      qualified_type_subtype CT qt1 qt3
  | qtype_refl : forall CT qt
      (Hdom      : sctype qt < dom CT)
      (Hnot_lost : sqtype qt <> Lost),
      qualified_type_subtype CT qt qt.

Definition vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (q1: q)(q2 : q) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM => Lost
    | q1, RDM => q1
    | _, q2 => q2
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_tt_abstract_state (t1: qualified_type)(t2 : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

From Stdlib Require Import List.

From Stdlib Require String.

Require Import Stdlib.Sets.Ensembles.

Require Import Stdlib.Classes.RelationClasses.

Import ListNotations.

Require Import Syntax Typing Subtyping ViewpointAdaptation Helpers.

Inductive reachable (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=

  | rch_heap : forall l
      (Hdom : l < dom h),
      reachable h l l

  | rch_step : forall l0 l1 obj f
      (Hdom    : l1 < dom h)
      (Hobj    : runtime_getObj h l0 = Some obj)
      (Hfield  : getVal obj.(fields_map) f = Some (Iot l1)),
      reachable h l0 l1

  | rch_trans : forall l0 l1 l2
      (Hreach1 : reachable h l0 l1)
      (Hreach2 : reachable h l1 l2),
      reachable h l0 l2.

Definition heap_edge (h : heap) (l0 l1 : Loc) : Prop :=
  exists obj f,
    runtime_getObj h l0 = Some obj /\
    getVal obj.(fields_map) f = Some (Iot l1) /\
    l1 < dom h.

Inductive edge_path (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> list Loc -> Prop :=
  | edge_path_nil : forall l,
      edge_path h l l []
  | edge_path_cons : forall l0 l1 l2 nodes,
      heap_edge h l0 l1 ->
      edge_path h l1 l2 nodes ->
      edge_path h l0 l2 (l1 :: nodes).

Fixpoint reachable_in (h : heap) (fuel : nat) (l0 l1 : Loc) : Prop :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => l0 = l1
  | S fuel' =>
      l0 = l1 \/
      exists next, heap_edge h l0 next /\ reachable_in h fuel' next l1
  end.

Inductive reachable_abs (CT : class_table) (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=

  | reachable_abs_heap : forall l
      (Hdom : l < dom h),
      reachable_abs CT h l l

  | reachable_abs_step : forall l0 l1 any C vals k
      (Hdom        : l1 < dom h)
      (Hobj        : runtime_getObj h l0 = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type any C) vals))
      (Hfield      : nth_error vals k = Some (Iot l1))
      (Hmut_abs    : sf_mutability_rel CT C k RDM_f \/ sf_mutability_rel CT C k Imm_f)
      (Hassign_abs : sf_assignability_rel CT C k RDA \/ sf_assignability_rel CT C k Final),
      reachable_abs CT h l0 l1

  | reachable_abs_trans : forall l0 l1 l2
      (Hreach1 : reachable_abs CT h l0 l1)
      (Hreach2 : reachable_abs CT h l1 l2),
      reachable_abs CT h l0 l2.

Definition protected_locset
  (CT : class_table) (h : heap) (l_root : Loc) : Ensembles.Ensemble Loc :=
  fun l_target => reachable_abs CT h l_root l_target.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Require Import Stdlib.Sets.Ensembles.

Definition get_this_var_mapping (vm : var_mapping) : option Loc :=
  match vm with
  | [] => None
  | ι :: _ =>
    match ι with
    | Null_a => None
    | Iot loc => Some loc
    end
  end.

Definition r_muttype (h: heap) (ι: Loc) : option q_r :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => None
  | Some o => Some (rqtype (rt_type o))
  end.

Definition r_basetype (h: heap) (ι: Loc) : option class_name :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => None
  | Some o => Some (rctype (rt_type o))
  end.

Definition r_type (h: heap) (ι: Loc) : option runtime_type :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => None
  | Some o => Some (rt_type o)
  end.

Definition update_field (h: heap) (ι: Loc) (f: var) (v: value) : heap :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => h
  | Some o =>
      let new_fields := update f v o.(fields_map) in
      let new_obj := (set_fields_map o (new_fields))
      in update ι new_obj h
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_runtime_bound_agree (q1: q_r)(q2 : q_c) : bool :=
  match (q1, q2) with
    | (Imm_r, RDM_c) => true
    | (Mut_r, RDM_c) => true
    | (Imm_r, Imm_c) => true
    | (Mut_r, Mut_c) => true
    | (_, _) => false
    end.

Definition wf_rtypeuse (CT: class_table) (q: q_r) (c: class_name) : Prop :=
  match (bound CT c) with
  | None => False
  | Some q' => c < dom CT /\ vpa_mutability_runtime_bound_agree q q'
  end.

Definition qualifier_typable_context (qr: q_r) (qs: q) (qcontext: q_r): Prop :=
  match qr with
  | Imm_r =>
    match vpa_mutability_runtime qcontext qs with
    | Imm => True
    | RO => True
    | Lost => True
    | _ => False
    end
  | Mut_r =>
    match vpa_mutability_runtime qcontext qs with
    | Mut => True
    | RO => True
    | Lost => True
    | _ => False
    end
  end.

Definition qualifier_typable_heap (qr: q_r) (qs: q): Prop :=
  match qr with
  | Imm_r =>
    match qs with
    | Imm => True
    | RO => True
    | _ => False
    end
  | Mut_r =>
    match qs with
    | Mut => True
    | RO => True
    | _ => False
    end
  end.

Definition wf_obj (CT: class_table) (h: heap) (ι: Loc) : Prop :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => False
  | Some o =>

      wf_rtypeuse CT (rt_type o).(rqtype) (rt_type o).(rctype) /\

      exists field_defs, CollectFields CT (rt_type o).(rctype) field_defs /\
      List.length (fields_map o) = List.length field_defs /\
      Forall2 (fun v fdef =>
        match v with
        | Null_a => True
        | Iot loc =>
          match runtime_getObj h loc with
          | Some _ =>

            exists rqt, r_type h loc = Some rqt /\
            base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (f_base_type (ftype fdef)) /\
            qualifier_typable_heap (rqtype rqt) (vpa_mutability_rec_fld (rqtype (rt_type o)) (mutability (ftype fdef)))
          | None => False
          end
        end) (fields_map o) field_defs
  end.

Definition wf_renv (CT: class_table) (rΓ: r_env) (h: heap) : Prop :=

  dom rΓ.(vars) > 0 /\
  (exists iot, get_this_var_mapping rΓ.(vars) = Some iot /\ iot < dom h) /\
  Forall (fun value =>
    match value with
    | Null_a => True
    | Iot loc =>
        match runtime_getObj h loc with
        | None => False
        | Some _ => True
        end
    end) rΓ.(vars).

Definition wf_heap (CT: class_table) (h: heap) : Prop :=
    forall (ι : Loc),
    ι < (List.length h) ->
    wf_obj CT h ι.

Definition wf_r_typable (CT: class_table) (h: heap) (ι: Loc)
  (sqt: qualified_type) (qcontext: q_r) : Prop :=
  match r_type h ι with
  | Some rqt =>
      base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype sqt) /\
      qualifier_typable_context (rqtype rqt) (sqtype sqt) qcontext
  | _ => False
  end.

Definition wf_r_config (CT: class_table) (sΓ: s_env) (rΓ: r_env) (h: heap) : Prop :=

  wf_class_table CT /\

  wf_heap CT h /\

  wf_renv CT rΓ h /\

  wf_senv CT sΓ /\

  List.length sΓ = List.length rΓ.(vars) /\
  forall ι qcontext,
  get_this_var_mapping (vars rΓ) = Some ι ->
  (r_muttype h ι) = Some qcontext ->
  forall i, i < List.length sΓ ->
  forall sqt,

    nth_error sΓ i = Some sqt ->
    match runtime_getVal rΓ i with
    | Some (Iot loc) => wf_r_typable CT h loc sqt qcontext
    | Some Null_a => True
    | None => False
    end.

Inductive eval_result :=
| OK : eval_result
| MUTATIONEXP: eval_result
| NPE : eval_result.

Definition runtime_vpa_assignability (q1: q_r) (a1: a) : a :=
  match q1, a1 with
    | _, Assignable => Assignable
    | Mut_r, RDA => Assignable
    | _, _ => Final
  end.

Definition reachable_locations_from_initial_env
  (h : heap) (rΓ : r_env) : Ensembles.Ensemble Loc :=
  fun l_target =>
    exists x l_root ,
      runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot l_root) /\
      reachable h l_root l_target.

Inductive eval_expr : class_table -> r_env -> heap -> expr -> value -> eval_result -> r_env -> heap -> Prop :=

  | EBS_Null : forall CT rΓ h,
      eval_expr CT rΓ h ENull Null_a OK rΓ h


  | EBS_Val : forall CT rΓ h x v
      (Hval : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some v),
      eval_expr CT rΓ h (EVar x) v OK rΓ h


  | EBS_Field : forall CT rΓ h x f v o v1
      (Hval   : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot v))
      (Hobj   : runtime_getObj h v = Some o)
      (Hfield : getVal o.(fields_map) f = Some v1),
      eval_expr CT rΓ h (EField x f) v1 OK rΓ h


  | EBS_Field_NPE : forall CT rΓ h x f
      (Hnull : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Null_a)),
      eval_expr CT rΓ h (EField x f) Null_a NPE rΓ h
  .

Inductive eval_stmt : class_table -> r_env -> heap -> stmt -> eval_result -> r_env -> heap -> Prop :=

  | SBS_Skip : forall CT rΓ h,
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h SSkip OK rΓ h


  | SBS_Local : forall CT rΓ h T x
      (Hnone : runtime_getVal rΓ x = None),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SLocal T x) OK
      (set_vars rΓ (rΓ.(vars)++[Null_a]) )
      h


  | SBS_Assign : forall CT rΓ h x e v1 v2
      (Hval   : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some v1)
      (Heval  : eval_expr CT rΓ h e v2 OK rΓ h),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SVarAss x e) OK
      (set_vars rΓ (update x v2 rΓ.(vars)))
      h

  | SBS_Assign_NPE : forall CT rΓ h x e v1 v2
      (Hval   : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some v1)
      (Heval  : eval_expr CT rΓ h e v2 NPE rΓ h),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SVarAss x e) NPE
      rΓ
      h


  | SBS_FldWrite : forall CT rΓ h x f y loc_x o a vf val_y h'
      (Hval_x  : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot loc_x))
      (Hobj    : runtime_getObj h loc_x = Some o)
      (Hfield  : getVal o.(fields_map) f = Some vf)
      (Hassign : sf_assignability_rel CT (rctype (rt_type o)) f a)
      (Hval_y  : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some val_y)
      (Hruntime_assignable : runtime_vpa_assignability (rqtype (rt_type o)) a = Assignable)
      (Hupdate : h' = update_field h loc_x f val_y),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SFldWrite x f y) OK rΓ h'


  | SBS_FldWrite_NPE : forall CT rΓ h x f y
      (Hnull : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Null_a)),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SFldWrite x f y) NPE rΓ h

  | SBS_FldWrite_MUTATIONEXP : forall CT rΓ h x f y loc_x o a vf val_y
      (Hval_x  : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot loc_x))
      (Hobj    : runtime_getObj h loc_x = Some o)
      (Hfield  : getVal o.(fields_map) f = Some vf)
      (Hassign : sf_assignability_rel CT (rctype (rt_type o)) f a)
      (Hval_y  : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some val_y)
      (Hfinal  : runtime_vpa_assignability (rqtype (rt_type o)) a = Final),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SFldWrite x f y) MUTATIONEXP rΓ h


  | SBS_New : forall CT rΓ h x (q_c:q_c) c ys l1 qthisr vals o qadapted rΓ' h'
      (Hthis    : runtime_getVal rΓ 0 = Some (Iot l1))
      (Hargs    : runtime_lookup_list rΓ ys = Some vals)
      (Hmut     : r_muttype h l1 = Some qthisr)
      (Hadapt   : vpa_mutability_object_creation qthisr q_c = qadapted)
      (Hobj     : o = mkObj (mkruntime_type qadapted c) (vals))
      (Hheap    : h' = h++[o])
      (Henv     : rΓ' = (set_vars rΓ (update x (Iot (dom h)) rΓ.(vars)))),

  | SBS_Call : forall CT rΓ h x y m zs vals ly cy mdef mbody mstmt mret retval h' rΓ' rΓ'' rΓ'''
      (Hval_y      : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly))
      (Hbase       : r_basetype h ly = Some cy)

      (Hretval     : runtime_getVal rΓ'' mret = Some retval)

   403	  constructor_def_lookup CT C = Some ctor /\
   404	  let sig := csignature ctor in

   411	
   412	  bound CT c = Some (cqualifier ctor) /\
   413	
   414

   416	
   417	
   418	  exists field_defs,
   419	    CollectFields CT c field_defs /\
   420	    length (cparams ctor) = length field_defs /\
   421	
   422	
   423	  Forall2 (fun param_type field_def =>
   424	    qualified_type_subtype CT
   425	      (vpa_mutability_constructor_param (cqualifier ctor) param_type)
   426	      {| sqtype := vpa_mutability_constructor_fld (cqualifier ctor) (mutability (ftype field_def));

   430	Definition wf_method (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) (mdef : method_def) : Prop :=
   431	  let mscope := mdef.(msignature).(mscope) in
   432	  let msig := msignature mdef in
   433	  let methodbody := mbody mdef in
   434	  let mbodystmt := mbody_stmt methodbody in
   435	  let sΓ := msig.(mreceiver) :: msig.(mparams) in
   436	  wf_stypeuse CT (sqtype (mret msig)) (sctype (mret msig)) /\
   437	  exists sΓ' mbodyrettype,
   438	    stmt_typing CT sΓ mscope mbodystmt sΓ' /\
   439	    let mbodyretvar := mreturn methodbody in
   440	    mbodyretvar < dom sΓ' /\
   441	    nth_error sΓ' mbodyretvar = Some mbodyrettype /\
   442	    qualified_type_subtype CT mbodyrettype (mret msig) /\
   443	    (forall parent_def parent mdef_parent qc,
   444	      find_class CT C = Some parent_def ->
   445	      super (signature parent_def) = Some parent ->
   446	      bound CT C = Some qc ->
   447	      FindMethodWithName CT parent (mname msig) mdef_parent ->
   448	      method_override_compatible CT qc msig (msignature mdef_parent)) /\
   449	    sctype (mreceiver msig) = C /\

   495	    forall i def, i > 0 -> find_class CT i = Some def ->

   501	  object_class_at_zero /\
   502	  non_object_classes_extend_object /\

From Stdlib Require Import List.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
Import ListNotations.
Require Import Syntax Notations Helpers Typing Subtyping Bigstep ViewpointAdaptation Reachability ConcreteState.

Lemma CollectFields_det :
  forall CT C fs1, CollectFields CT C fs1 ->
    forall fs2, CollectFields CT C fs2 -> fs1 = fs2.
Proof.
  intros CT C fs1 H1.
  induction H1; intros fs2 H2; inversion H2; subst.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite Hfind in Hfind0. injection Hfind0 as ->. rewrite Hsuper in Hsuper0. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hfind in Hfind0. injection Hfind0 as ->. rewrite Hsuper in Hsuper0. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hfind in Hfind0. injection Hfind0 as ->.
    rewrite Hsuper in Hsuper0. injection Hsuper0 as ->.
    rewrite (IHCollectFields parent_fields0 Hparent_cf). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma FieldLookup_det :
  forall CT C f fd1 fd2,
    FieldLookup CT C f fd1 -> FieldLookup CT C f fd2 -> fd1 = fd2.
Proof.
  intros CT C f fd1 fd2 H1 H2.
  destruct H1 as [CT1 C1 fs1 f1 fd1' Hcf1 Hg1].
  destruct H2 as [CT2 C2 fs2 f2 fd2' Hcf2 Hg2].
  assert (fs1 = fs2) as -> by (eapply CollectFields_det; eauto).
  rewrite Hg1 in Hg2. injection Hg2 as ->. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma Forall2_nth_error_Some :
  forall {A B : Type} (R : A -> B -> Prop) (l1 : list A) (l2 : list B) n x,
    Forall2 R l1 l2 -> nth_error l1 n = Some x ->
    exists y, nth_error l2 n = Some y /\ R x y.
Proof. intros A B R l1. induction l1 as [|a l1 IH]; intros l2 n x Hfa Hn.
  - destruct n; simpl in Hn; discriminate.
  - destruct l2 as [|b l2]. + inversion Hfa.
    + destruct n as [|n']; simpl in *.
      * injection Hn as ->. inversion Hfa as [|? ? HR Hfa']; subst. exists b; split; auto.
      * inversion Hfa as [|? ? HR Hfa']; subst. eapply IH; eauto. Qed.

Lemma r_type_Some : forall (h : heap) (l : Loc) (rt : runtime_type),
    r_type h l = Some rt -> exists o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o /\ rt_type o = rt.
Proof. intros h l rt H. unfold r_type in H.
  destruct (runtime_getObj h l) as [o|] eqn:E.
  - exists o; split; auto. injection H as Hrt. exact Hrt.
  - discriminate. Qed.

Lemma nth_error_Some_lt : forall {X : Type} (l : list X) n x,
    nth_error l n = Some x -> n < length l.
Proof. intros X l n x H. apply (proj1 (nth_error_Some l n)). rewrite H. discriminate. Qed.

    wf_heap CT h ->

    assert (Hsome : Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type any C) vals) =

    rewrite Hobj in Hwfo.

      { apply (FL_Found CT C0 field_defs k fd Hcf). unfold gget. exact Hnth. }
      assert (Hfd_eq : fd = fd') by (eapply FieldLookup_det; eauto).
      subst fd'. rewrite Hmut' in Hqual.

      * discriminate Hqual.
      * destruct (r_type_Some h l1 (mkruntime_type Imm_r rc) Hrtype) as [o [Eo Hrt_eq]].
        destruct o as [rt fm]. cbn in Hrt_eq. subst rt.
        exists rc, fm. exact Eo.
    + assert (Hfl_fd : FieldLookup CT C0 k fd).
      { apply (FL_Found CT C0 field_defs k fd Hcf). unfold gget. exact Hnth. }
      assert (Hfd_eq : fd = fd') by (eapply FieldLookup_det; eauto).

      * discriminate Hqual.
      * destruct (r_type_Some h l1 (mkruntime_type Imm_r rc) Hrtype) as [o [Eo Hrt_eq]].
        destruct o as [rt fm]. cbn in Hrt_eq. subst rt.
        exists rc, fm. exact Eo.
  - apply IHHreach2. apply IHHreach1. exact Himm.

Lemma CollectFields_det :

  forall {A B : Type} (R : A -> B -> Prop) (l1 : list A) (l2 : list B) n x,
    Forall2 R l1 l2 -> nth_error l1 n = Some x ->
    exists y, nth_error l2 n = Some y /\ R x y.
Proof. intros A B R l1. induction l1 as [|a l1 IH]; intros l2 n x Hfa Hn.

From Stdlib Require Import List.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
Import ListNotations.
Require Import Syntax Notations Helpers Typing Subtyping Bigstep ViewpointAdaptation Reachability ConcreteState.

Lemma nth_error_update_neq :
  forall {X : Type} (l : list X) n v m,
    m <> n -> nth_error (update n v l) m = nth_error l m.
Proof.
  intros X l. induction l as [|x xs IH]; intros n v m Hneq.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct n as [|n']; destruct m as [|m'].
    + exfalso; apply Hneq; reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
    + simpl. apply IH. intros H; apply Hneq. now rewrite H.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_update_eq :
  forall {X : Type} (l : list X) n v,
    n < length l -> nth_error (update n v l) n = Some v.
Proof.
  intros X l. induction l as [|x xs IH]; intros [|n] v Hlen.
  - simpl in Hlen; lia.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl in Hlen; lia.
  - simpl. simpl in Hlen. apply IH. lia.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_app_l :
  forall {X : Type} (l1 l2 : list X) n x,
    nth_error l1 n = Some x -> nth_error (l1 ++ l2) n = Some x.
Proof.
  intros X l1. induction l1 as [|a l1 IH]; intros l2 n x H.
  - destruct n; simpl in *; discriminate.
  - destruct n as [|n']; simpl in *; auto. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_Some_lt :
  forall {X : Type} (l : list X) n x,
    nth_error l n = Some x -> n < length l.
Proof.
  intros X l n x H. apply (proj1 (nth_error_Some l n)). rewrite H. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma CollectFields_det :
  forall CT C fs1, CollectFields CT C fs1 ->
    forall fs2, CollectFields CT C fs2 -> fs1 = fs2.
Proof.
  intros CT C fs1 H1.
  induction H1; intros fs2 H2; inversion H2; subst.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite Hfind in Hfind0. injection Hfind0 as ->. rewrite Hsuper in Hsuper0. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hfind in Hfind0. injection Hfind0 as ->. rewrite Hsuper in Hsuper0. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hfind in Hfind0. injection Hfind0 as ->.
    rewrite Hsuper in Hsuper0. injection Hsuper0 as ->.
    rewrite (IHCollectFields parent_fields0 Hparent_cf). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma FieldLookup_det :
  forall CT C f fd1 fd2,
    FieldLookup CT C f fd1 -> FieldLookup CT C f fd2 -> fd1 = fd2.
Proof.
  intros CT C f fd1 fd2 H1 H2.
  destruct H1 as [CT1 C1 fs1 f1 fd1' Hcf1 Hg1].
  destruct H2 as [CT2 C2 fs2 f2 fd2' Hcf2 Hg2].
  assert (fs1 = fs2) as -> by (eapply CollectFields_det; eauto).
  rewrite Hg1 in Hg2. injection Hg2 as ->. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sf_assignability_rel_det :
  forall CT C f a1 a2,
    sf_assignability_rel CT C f a1 -> sf_assignability_rel CT C f a2 -> a1 = a2.
Proof.
  intros CT C f a1 a2 [d1 [Hl1 Ha1]] [d2 [Hl2 Ha2]].
  assert (d1 = d2) as -> by (eapply FieldLookup_det; eauto).
  rewrite Ha1 in Ha2. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Forall2_nth_error_Some :
  forall {A B : Type} (R : A -> B -> Prop) (l1 : list A) (l2 : list B) n x,
    Forall2 R l1 l2 -> nth_error l1 n = Some x ->
    exists y, nth_error l2 n = Some y /\ R x y.
Proof.
  intros A B R l1.
  induction l1 as [|a l1 IH]; intros l2 n x Hfa Hn.
  - destruct n; simpl in Hn; discriminate.

  destruct (runtime_getObj h l) as [o|] eqn:E.
  - exists o; split; auto. injection H as Hrt. exact Hrt.

  abs_heaps_related CT h1 h2 -> abs_heaps_related CT h2 h3 -> abs_heaps_related CT h1 h3.

Require Import Syntax Notations Helpers Typing Subtyping Bigstep ViewpointAdaptation Reachability ConcreteState.

Lemma nth_error_update_neq :
  forall {X : Type} (l : list X) n v m,
    m <> n -> nth_error (update n v l) m = nth_error l m.
Proof.
  intros X l. induction l as [|x xs IH]; intros n v m Hneq.
  - destruct n; reflexivity.
  - destruct n as [|n']; destruct m as [|m'].
    + exfalso; apply Hneq; reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
    + simpl. apply IH. intros H; apply Hneq. now rewrite H.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_update_eq :
  forall {X : Type} (l : list X) n v,
    n < length l -> nth_error (update n v l) n = Some v.
Proof.
  intros X l. induction l as [|x xs IH]; intros [|n] v Hlen.
  - simpl in Hlen; lia.
  - simpl in Hlen; lia.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. simpl in Hlen. apply IH. lia.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_app_l :
  forall {X : Type} (l1 l2 : list X) n x,
    nth_error l1 n = Some x -> nth_error (l1 ++ l2) n = Some x.
Proof.
  intros X l1. induction l1 as [|a l1 IH]; intros l2 n x H.
  - destruct n; simpl in *; discriminate.
  - destruct n as [|n']; simpl in *.
    + auto.
    + apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_Some_lt :
  forall {X : Type} (l : list X) n x,
    nth_error l n = Some x -> n < length l.
Proof.
  intros X l n x H. apply (proj1 (nth_error_Some l n)). rewrite H. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma CollectFields_det :
  forall CT C fs1, CollectFields CT C fs1 ->
    forall fs2, CollectFields CT C fs2 -> fs1 = fs2.
Proof.
  intros CT C fs1 H1.
  induction H1; intros fs2 H2; inversion H2; subst.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite Hfind in Hfind0. injection Hfind0 as ->. rewrite Hsuper in Hsuper0. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hfind in Hfind0. injection Hfind0 as ->. rewrite Hsuper in Hsuper0. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hfind in Hfind0. injection Hfind0 as ->.
    rewrite Hsuper in Hsuper0. injection Hsuper0 as ->.
    rewrite (IHCollectFields parent_fields0 Hparent_cf). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma FieldLookup_det :
  forall CT C f fd1 fd2,
    FieldLookup CT C f fd1 -> FieldLookup CT C f fd2 -> fd1 = fd2.
Proof.
  intros CT C f fd1 fd2 H1 H2.
  destruct H1 as [CT1 C1 fs1 f1 fd1' Hcf1 Hg1].
  destruct H2 as [CT2 C2 fs2 f2 fd2' Hcf2 Hg2].
  assert (fs1 = fs2) as -> by (eapply CollectFields_det; eauto).
  rewrite Hg1 in Hg2. injection Hg2 as ->. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sf_assignability_rel_det :
  forall CT C f a1 a2,
    sf_assignability_rel CT C f a1 -> sf_assignability_rel CT C f a2 -> a1 = a2.
Proof.
  intros CT C f a1 a2 [d1 [Hl1 Ha1]] [d2 [Hl2 Ha2]].
  assert (d1 = d2) as -> by (eapply FieldLookup_det; eauto).
  rewrite Ha1 in Ha2. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Forall2_nth_error_Some :
  forall {A B : Type} (R : A -> B -> Prop) (l1 : list A) (l2 : list B) n x,
    Forall2 R l1 l2 -> nth_error l1 n = Some x ->
    exists y, nth_error l2 n = Some y /\ R x y.
Proof.
  intros A B R l1.
  induction l1 as [|a l1 IH]; intros l2 n x Hfa Hn.
  - destruct n; simpl in Hn; discriminate.
  - destruct l2 as [|b l2].
    + inversion Hfa.
    + destruct n as [|n']; simpl in *.
      * injection Hn as ->. inversion Hfa as [|? ? HR Hfa']; subst.
        exists b; split; auto.
      * inversion Hfa as [|? ? HR Hfa']; subst.
        eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma r_type_Some :
  forall (h : heap) (l : Loc) (rt : runtime_type),
    r_type h l = Some rt ->
    exists o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o /\ rt_type o = rt.
Proof.
  intros h l rt H. unfold r_type in H.
  destruct (runtime_getObj h l) as [o|] eqn:E.
  - exists o; split; auto. injection H as Hrt. exact Hrt.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma reachable_abs_imm :
  forall CT h l0 l,
    wf_heap CT h ->
    reachable_abs CT h l0 l ->
    (exists C vals, runtime_getObj h l0 = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type Imm_r C) vals)) ->
    exists C vals, runtime_getObj h l = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type Imm_r C) vals).
Proof.
  intros CT h a b Hwf Hreach.
  induction Hreach; intros Himm.
  - exact Himm.
  - destruct Himm as [C0 [vals0 Himm0]].
    assert (Hsome : Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type any C) vals) =
                   Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type Imm_r C0) vals0)).
    { rewrite <- Hobj, <- Himm0. reflexivity. }
    injection Hsome as Hany HC Hvals.
    subst any. subst C. subst vals.
    assert (Hdom0 : l0 < dom h) by (eapply nth_error_Some_lt; eauto).
    pose proof (Hwf l0 Hdom0) as Hwfo.
    unfold wf_obj in Hwfo. rewrite Hobj in Hwfo. cbn in Hwfo.
    destruct Hwfo as (Hwfrt & field_defs & Hcf & Hlen & Hfa2).
    destruct (Forall2_nth_error_Some _ _ _ _ _ Hfa2 Hfield) as [fd [Hnth Hr]].
    destruct Hmut_abs as [[fd' [Hfl' Hmut']] | [fd' [Hfl' Hmut']]].
    + assert (Hfl_fd : FieldLookup CT C0 k fd).
      { apply (FL_Found CT C0 field_defs k fd Hcf). unfold gget. exact Hnth. }
      assert (Hfd_eq : fd = fd') by (eapply FieldLookup_det; eauto).
      subst fd'. rewrite Hmut' in Hr. cbn in Hr.
      destruct (runtime_getObj h l1) as [o1|] eqn:Eo1.
      * cbn in Hr. destruct Hr as [rqt [Hrtype [Hbsub Hqual]]].
        unfold r_type in Hrtype. rewrite Eo1 in Hrtype. injection Hrtype as Hrt_eq.
        destruct o1 as [rt fm]. cbn in Hrt_eq. subst rt.
        destruct rqt as [rq rc]. cbn in Hqual.
        destruct rq; cbn in Hqual.
        -- destruct Hqual.
        -- exists rc, fm. reflexivity.
      * cbn in Hr. destruct Hr.
    + assert (Hfl_fd2 : FieldLookup CT C0 k fd).
      { apply (FL_Found CT C0 field_defs k fd Hcf). unfold gget. exact Hnth. }
      assert (Hfd_eq2 : fd = fd') by (eapply FieldLookup_det; eauto).
      subst fd'. rewrite Hmut' in Hr. cbn in Hr.
      destruct (runtime_getObj h l1) as [o1|] eqn:Eo2.
      * cbn in Hr. destruct Hr as [rqt2 [Hrtype2 [Hbsub2 Hqual2]]].
        unfold r_type in Hrtype2. rewrite Eo2 in Hrtype2. injection Hrtype2 as Hrt_eq2.
        destruct o1 as [rt2 fm2]. cbn in Hrt_eq2. subst rt2.
        destruct rqt2 as [rq2 rc2]. cbn in Hqual2.
        destruct rq2; cbn in Hqual2.
        -- destruct Hqual2.
        -- exists rc2, fm2. reflexivity.
      * cbn in Hr. destruct Hr.
  - apply IHHreach2. apply IHHreach1. exact Himm.
Qed.

Definition abs_heaps_related (CT : class_table) (h h' : heap) : Prop :=
  forall l qr C vals,
    runtime_getObj h l = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type qr C) vals) ->
    qr = Imm_r ->
    exists vals',
      runtime_getObj h' l = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type qr C) vals') /\
      forall f,
        (sf_assignability_rel CT C f Final \/ sf_assignability_rel CT C f RDA) ->
        nth_error vals f = nth_error vals' f.

Lemma abs_heaps_related_refl : forall CT h, abs_heaps_related CT h h.
Proof. intros CT h l qr C vals Hobj Hqr. exists vals. split; auto. Qed.

Lemma abs_heaps_related_trans : forall CT h1 h2 h3,
  abs_heaps_related CT h1 h2 -> abs_heaps_related CT h2 h3 -> abs_heaps_related CT h1 h3.
Proof.
  intros CT h1 h2 h3 H12 H23 l qr C vals H1 Hqr.
  destruct (H12 l qr C vals H1 Hqr) as [vals2 [Hobj2 Hpre2]].
  destruct (H23 l qr C vals2 Hobj2 Hqr) as [vals3 [Hobj3 Hpre3]].
  exists vals3. split; auto.
  intros f Hprot. rewrite (Hpre2 f Hprot). apply Hpre3; auto.
Qed.

Lemma abs_heaps_related_app : forall CT h o, abs_heaps_related CT h (h ++ [o]).
Proof.
  intros CT h o l qr C vals H1 Hqr. exists vals. split; auto.
  eapply nth_error_app_l; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma update_field_other : forall h loc f v l,
  l <> loc -> runtime_getObj (update_field h loc f v) l = runtime_getObj h l.
Proof.
  intros. unfold update_field.
  destruct (runtime_getObj h loc) as [o|] eqn:E.
  - apply nth_error_update_neq. auto.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma update_field_same : forall h loc f v o,
  runtime_getObj h loc = Some o ->
  runtime_getObj (update_field h loc f v) loc =
  Some (set_fields_map o (update f v (fields_map o))).
Proof.
  intros h loc f v o Hobj. unfold update_field. rewrite Hobj.
  apply nth_error_update_eq. eapply nth_error_Some_lt; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma abs_heaps_related_write :
  forall CT h loc fd val a o,
    runtime_getObj h loc = Some o ->
    sf_assignability_rel CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fd a ->
    runtime_vpa_assignability (rqtype (rt_type o)) a = Assignable ->
    abs_heaps_related CT h (update_field h loc fd val).
Proof.
  intros CT h loc fd val a o Hobj Hassign Hrt l qr C vals Hl Hqr.
  destruct (Nat.eq_dec l loc) as [Heq|Hne].
  - subst l.
    rewrite Hobj in Hl. injection Hl as Ho. subst o. subst qr.
    cbn in Hassign.
    assert (Ha : a = Assignable) by (destruct a; cbn in Hrt; try discriminate; reflexivity).
    subst a.
    exists (update fd val vals). split.
    + rewrite (update_field_same h loc fd val (mkObj (mkruntime_type Imm_r C) vals) Hobj).
      cbn. reflexivity.
    + intros g Hg.
      assert (Hneq : fd <> g).
      { intro Hfg. subst g.
        destruct Hg as [Hg|Hg].
        - pose proof (sf_assignability_rel_det CT C fd Assignable Final Hassign Hg). discriminate.
        - pose proof (sf_assignability_rel_det CT C fd Assignable RDA Hassign Hg). discriminate. }
      symmetry. apply nth_error_update_neq.
      intro H; apply Hneq; now symmetry.
  - exists vals. split.
    + rewrite (update_field_other h loc fd val l Hne). exact Hl.
    + auto.
Qed.

Lemma eval_stmt_abs_heaps_related :
  forall CT rΓ h stmt res rΓ' h',
    eval_stmt CT rΓ h stmt res rΓ' h' -> abs_heaps_related CT h h'.
Proof.
  intros CT rΓ h stmt res rΓ' h' Heval.
  induction Heval; try apply abs_heaps_related_refl.
  - rewrite Hupdate. eapply abs_heaps_related_write; eauto.
  - rewrite Hheap. apply abs_heaps_related_app.
  - exact IHHeval.
  - exact IHHeval.
  - exact IHHeval.
  - eapply abs_heaps_related_trans; eauto.
  - exact IHHeval.
  - eapply abs_heaps_related_trans; eauto.
  - exact IHHeval.
  - eapply abs_heaps_related_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Theorem abstract_state_preservation :
  forall CT sΓ mt rΓ h stmt rΓ' h' sΓ' root C0 vals0 l C qr vals f
    (Himm_root : runtime_getObj h root = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type Imm_r C0) vals0))
    (Hreach : reachable_abs CT h root l)
    (Hwf : wf_r_config CT sΓ rΓ h)
    (Htyping : stmt_typing CT sΓ mt stmt sΓ')
    (Heval : eval_stmt CT rΓ h stmt OK rΓ' h')
    (Hobj : runtime_getObj h l = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type qr C) vals))
    (Hprotected : sf_assignability_rel CT C f Final \/
                  sf_assignability_rel CT C f RDA),
    exists vals',
      runtime_getObj h' l = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type qr C) vals') /\
      nth_error vals f = nth_error vals' f.
Proof.
  intros CT sΓ mt rΓ h stmt rΓ' h' sΓ' root C0 vals0 l C qr vals f
         Himm_root Hreach Hwf Htyping Heval Hobj Hprotected.
  destruct Hwf as (HwfCT & Hwfheap & _).
  assert (Himm_l : exists C1 vals1,
            runtime_getObj h l = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type Imm_r C1) vals1)).
  { eapply reachable_abs_imm.
    - exact Hwfheap.
    - exact Hreach.
    - exists C0, vals0. exact Himm_root. }
  destruct Himm_l as [C1 [vals1 Hl]].
  rewrite Hobj in Hl. injection Hl as Hqr HC Hvals.
  pose proof (eval_stmt_abs_heaps_related CT rΓ h stmt OK rΓ' h' Heval) as Hrel.
  destruct (Hrel l qr C vals Hobj Hqr) as [vals' [Hobj' Hpre]].
  exists vals'. split.
  - exact Hobj'.
  - apply Hpre. exact Hprotected.
Qed.

  abs_heaps_related CT h1 h2 -> abs_heaps_related CT h2 h3 -> abs_heaps_related CT h1 h3.
Proof.
  intros CT h1 h2 h3 H12 H23 l qr C vals H1 Hqr.
  destruct (H12 l qr C vals H1 Hqr) as [vals2 [Hobj2 Hpre2]].
  destruct (H23 l qr C vals2 Hobj2 Hqr) as [vals3 [Hobj3 Hpre3]].
  exists vals3. split; auto.
  intros f Hprot. rewrite (Hpre2 f Hprot). apply Hpre3; auto.
Qed.

Proof.

Lemma update_field_other : forall h loc f v l,

Proof.

  destruct (runtime_getObj h loc) as [o|] eqn:E.
  - apply nth_error_update_neq. auto.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma update_field_same : forall h loc f v o,
  runtime_getObj h loc = Some o ->
  runtime_getObj (update_field h loc f v) loc =

Proof.
  intros h loc f v o Hobj. unfold update_field. rewrite Hobj.
  apply nth_error_update_eq. eapply nth_error_Some_lt; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma abs_heaps_related_write :
  forall CT h loc fd val a o,
    runtime_getObj h loc = Some o ->
    sf_assignability_rel CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fd a ->
    runtime_vpa_assignability (rqtype (rt_type o)) a = Assignable ->
    abs_heaps_related CT h (update_field h loc fd val).
Proof.
  intros CT h loc fd val a o Hobj Hassign Hrt l qr C vals Hl Hqr.
  destruct (Nat.eq_dec l loc) as [Heq|Hne].
  - subst l.
    rewrite Hobj in Hl. injection Hl as Ho. subst o. subst qr.
    cbn in Hassign.
    assert (Ha : a = Assignable) by (destruct a; cbn in Hrt; try discriminate; reflexivity).
    subst a.
    exists (update fd val vals). split.
    + rewrite (update_field_same h loc fd val (mkObj (mkruntime_type Imm_r C) vals) Hobj).
      cbn. reflexivity.
    + intros g Hg.
      assert (Hneq : fd <> g).
      { intro Hfg. subst g.
        destruct Hg as [Hg|Hg].
        - pose proof (sf_assignability_rel_det CT C fd Assignable Final Hassign Hg). discriminate.
        - pose proof (sf_assignability_rel_det CT C fd Assignable RDA Hassign Hg). discriminate. }
      symmetry. apply nth_error_update_neq.
      intro H; apply Hneq; now symmetry.
  - exists vals. split.
    + rewrite (update_field_other h loc fd val l Hne). exact Hl.
    + auto.
Qed.

Lemma eval_stmt_abs_heaps_related :
  forall CT rΓ h stmt res rΓ' h',
    eval_stmt CT rΓ h stmt res rΓ' h' -> abs_heaps_related CT h h'.
Proof.
  intros CT rΓ h stmt res rΓ' h' Heval.
  induction Heval; try apply abs_heaps_related_refl.
  - rewrite Hupdate. eapply abs_heaps_related_write; eauto.
  - rewrite Hheap. apply abs_heaps_related_app.
  - exact IHHeval.
  - exact IHHeval.
  - exact IHHeval.
  - eapply abs_heaps_related_trans; eauto.
  - exact IHHeval.
  - eapply abs_heaps_related_trans; eauto.
  - exact IHHeval.
  - eapply abs_heaps_related_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Theorem abstract_state_preservation :
  forall CT sΓ mt rΓ h stmt rΓ' h' sΓ' root C0 vals0 l C qr vals f
    (Himm_root : runtime_getObj h root = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type Imm_r C0) vals0))
    (Hreach : reachable_abs CT h root l)
    (Hwf : wf_r_config CT sΓ rΓ h)
    (Htyping : stmt_typing CT sΓ mt stmt sΓ')
    (Heval : eval_stmt CT rΓ h stmt OK rΓ' h')
    (Hobj : runtime_getObj h l = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type qr C) vals))
    (Hprotected : sf_assignability_rel CT C f Final \/
                  sf_assignability_rel CT C f RDA),
    exists vals',
      runtime_getObj h' l = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type qr C) vals') /\
      nth_error vals f = nth_error vals' f.
Proof.
  intros CT sΓ mt rΓ h stmt rΓ' h' sΓ' root C0 vals0 l C qr vals f
         Himm_root Hreach Hwf Htyping Heval Hobj Hprotected.
  destruct Hwf as (HwfCT & Hwfheap & _).
  assert (Himm_l : exists C1 vals1,
            runtime_getObj h l = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type Imm_r C1) vals1)).
  { eapply reachable_abs_imm.
    - exact Hwfheap.
    - exact Hreach.
    - exists C0, vals0. exact Himm_root. }
  destruct Himm_l as [C1 [vals1 Hl]].
  rewrite Hobj in Hl. injection Hl as Hqr HC Hvals.
  pose proof (eval_stmt_abs_heaps_related CT rΓ h stmt OK rΓ' h' Heval) as Hrel.
  destruct (Hrel l qr C vals Hobj Hqr) as [vals' [Hobj' Hpre]].
  exists vals'. split.
  - exact Hobj'.
  - apply Hpre. exact Hprotected.
Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Lemma nth_error_update_neq :
  forall {X : Type} (l : list X) n v m,
    m <> n -> nth_error (update n v l) m = nth_error l m.
Proof.
  intros X l. induction l as [|x xs IH]; intros n v m Hneq.
  - destruct n; reflexivity.
  - destruct n as [|n']; destruct m as [|m'].
    + exfalso; apply Hneq; reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
    + simpl. apply IH. intros H; apply Hneq. now rewrite H.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_update_eq :
  forall {X : Type} (l : list X) n v,
    n < length l -> nth_error (update n v l) n = Some v.
Proof.
  intros X l. induction l as [|x xs IH]; intros [|n] v Hlen.
  - simpl in Hlen; lia.
  - simpl in Hlen; lia.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. simpl in Hlen. apply IH. lia.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_app_l :
  forall {X : Type} (l1 l2 : list X) n x,
    nth_error l1 n = Some x -> nth_error (l1 ++ l2) n = Some x.
Proof.
  intros X l1. induction l1 as [|a l1 IH]; intros l2 n x H.
  - destruct n; simpl in *; discriminate.
  - destruct n as [|n']; simpl in *.
    + auto.
    + apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_Some_lt :
  forall {X : Type} (l : list X) n x,
    nth_error l n = Some x -> n < length l.
Proof.
  intros X l n x H. apply (proj1 (nth_error_Some l n)). rewrite H. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma CollectFields_det :
  forall CT C fs1, CollectFields CT C fs1 ->
    forall fs2, CollectFields CT C fs2 -> fs1 = fs2.
Proof.
  intros CT C fs1 H1.
  induction H1; intros fs2 H2; inversion H2; subst.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite Hfind in Hfind0. injection Hfind0 as ->. rewrite Hsuper in Hsuper0. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hfind in Hfind0. injection Hfind0 as ->. rewrite Hsuper in Hsuper0. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hfind in Hfind0. injection Hfind0 as ->.
    rewrite Hsuper in Hsuper0. injection Hsuper0 as ->.
    rewrite (IHCollectFields parent_fields0 Hparent_cf). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma FieldLookup_det :
  forall CT C f fd1 fd2,
    FieldLookup CT C f fd1 -> FieldLookup CT C f fd2 -> fd1 = fd2.
Proof.
  intros CT C f fd1 fd2 H1 H2.
  destruct H1 as [CT1 C1 fs1 f1 fd1' Hcf1 Hg1].
  destruct H2 as [CT2 C2 fs2 f2 fd2' Hcf2 Hg2].
  assert (fs1 = fs2) as -> by (eapply CollectFields_det; eauto).
  rewrite Hg1 in Hg2. injection Hg2 as ->. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sf_assignability_rel_det :
  forall CT C f a1 a2,
    sf_assignability_rel CT C f a1 -> sf_assignability_rel CT C f a2 -> a1 = a2.
Proof.
  intros CT C f a1 a2 [d1 [Hl1 Ha1]] [d2 [Hl2 Ha2]].
  assert (d1 = d2) as -> by (eapply FieldLookup_det; eauto).
  rewrite Ha1 in Ha2. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Forall2_nth_error_Some :
  forall {A B : Type} (R : A -> B -> Prop) (l1 : list A) (l2 : list B) n x,
    Forall2 R l1 l2 -> nth_error l1 n = Some x ->
    exists y, nth_error l2 n = Some y /\ R x y.
Proof.
  intros A B R l1.
  induction l1 as [|a l1 IH]; intros l2 n x Hfa Hn.
  - destruct n; simpl in Hn; discriminate.
  - destruct l2 as [|b l2].
    + inversion Hfa.
    + destruct n as [|n']; simpl in *.
      * injection Hn as ->. inversion Hfa as [|? ? HR Hfa']; subst.
        exists b; split; auto.
      * inversion Hfa as [|? ? HR Hfa']; subst.
        eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma r_type_Some :
  forall (h : heap) (l : Loc) (rt : runtime_type),
    r_type h l = Some rt ->
    exists o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o /\ rt_type o = rt.
Proof.
  intros h l rt H. unfold r_type in H.
  destruct (runtime_getObj h l) as [o|] eqn:E.
  - exists o; split; auto. injection H as Hrt. exact Hrt.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma reachable_abs_imm :

        destruct rq; cbn in Hqual.
        -- destruct Hqual.
        -- exists rc, fm. reflexivity.
      * cbn in Hr. destruct Hr.
    + assert (Hfl_fd2 : FieldLookup CT C0 k fd).
      { apply (FL_Found CT C0 field_defs k fd Hcf). unfold gget. exact Hnth. }
      assert (Hfd_eq2 : fd = fd') by (eapply FieldLookup_det; eauto).

Definition abs_heaps_related (CT : class_table) (h h' : heap) : Prop :=
  forall l qr C vals,
    runtime_getObj h l = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type qr C) vals) ->
    qr = Imm_r ->
    exists vals',
      runtime_getObj h' l = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type qr C) vals') /\
      forall f,
        (sf_assignability_rel CT C f Final \/ sf_assignability_rel CT C f RDA) ->
        nth_error vals f = nth_error vals' f.

Proof. intros CT h l qr C vals Hobj Hqr. exists vals. split; auto. Qed.

Lemma abs_heaps_related_trans : forall CT h1 h2 h3,

Proof.
  intros CT h1 h2 h3 H12 H23 l qr C vals H1 Hqr.
  destruct (H12 l qr C vals H1 Hqr) as [vals2 [Hobj2 Hpre2]].
  destruct (H23 l qr C vals2 Hobj2 Hqr) as [vals3 [Hobj3 Hpre3]].
  exists vals3. split; auto.
  intros f Hprot. rewrite (Hpre2 f Hprot). apply Hpre3; auto.
Qed.
